description: Rajasthan teacher used AI for fake deputation letters. Follow Bhaskar English Latest Updates. In Rajasthan, a Grade-III teacher used AI to generate fake deputation letters, facilitating joinings at any school in any district. He charged ₹50,000 for each counterfeit deputation letter, duping individuals by boasting of high-level contacts with ministers and senior officials.
body_lead: Bhaskar InvestigationRajasthan transfer ban, yet preferred school postings:Govt teacher sold AI-faked deputation letters; 5 joined - Copy link In Rajasthan, a Grade-III teacher used AI to generate fake deputation letters, facilitating joinings at any school in any district. He charged ₹50,000 for each counterfeit deputation letter, duping individuals by boasting of high-level contacts with ministers and senior officials. The fake deputation scam came to light recently after an FIR was lodged in a female teacher's case.
